Container.Name: breakfix-postgres
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL 15 database for BreakFix Triage. Keep this container running before starting the breakfix-triage app container. Both containers must be attached to the same custom Docker network (default: breakfix-net) so they can reach each other by container name.
Container.Requires: A user-defined Docker network called "breakfix-net" must exist. Create it from Unraid's Docker settings or via: docker network create breakfix-net

Config.Name: Postgres Data
Config.Description: Where Postgres stores its data on the Unraid array. Do not change after the first start unless you also migrate the data.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_DB
Config.Description: Database name. Must match the database used in the app container's DATABASE_URL.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_USER
Config.Description: Database user. Must match the app container's DATABASE_URL.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Database password. Choose a long random string. Must match the password inside the app container's DATABASE_URL.
